target: Darwin ARM64 source-native CLI and adjacent compiled recipe
installation_boundary: The actual existing builder/platform attestation helper checks exact binary, image, symbol and bootstrap hashes. Original and restored pairs pass; the valid different pair refuses its original installation attestation.

stages.actual_stdout: form-cli behavioral proof: OK (identity, v2/v1, exact bytes, 1546-row rank, embed batch/cap, request HMAC/replay)

limits: Raw stage and boundary streams remain at their exact retained capture paths. The source checks are cooperative before/after observations; wall time and retained resource snapshots do not establish peak memory or general throughput. Earlier refused attempts retain their original runtime/source identities.
launch_boundary: Default startup checks the complete clean symbol record and native program compatibility. It intentionally accepts a different compatible recipe compiled by the same generated binary. The baked stamp identifies the generated source; exact companion byte binding is checked during build and installation.
hashing: The existing Form-emitted CPU SHA owner hashes exact held bytes and requires ready plus buffer/pipeline retirement. Original source seals and stage identities retain their streaming-SHA observations; artifact observers bind exact held bytes with the same owned CPU SHA.
